_readme: MASTER SWITCH for advertising on forgeflowgames.com. Everything here ships OFF. Portal ad slots are decided at BUILD time (run pipeline/deploy_portal.py after editing); the in-game SDK (forgeflow-sdk.js) fetches this same file at RUNTIME. ads.txt is generated from publisherId by scripts/build-seo.mjs, so it can never drift from this file.
_publisherIdNote: The ForgeFlow Games AdSense publisher id, copied from the AdSense site-setup screen on 2026-10-06. NOTE it is a DIFFERENT account from Revuzia (pub-4272113962717102). ads.txt and the <head> snippet are both generated from this one value.

slots._note: AdSense display-unit IDs (10 digits), created in AdSense > Ads > By ad unit AFTER the site is approved. An empty string keeps that slot invisible.

inGame._note: Midgame / rewarded ads inside games, via the SDK's ForgeFlow.ads.requestAd(). Needs AdSense 'H5 Games Ads' approval AND a verified domain for the game host. Rules follow CrazyGames' published pacing: at most one midgame ad per 3 minutes, none during the first 3 minutes after load, rewarded ads optional and time-limited.
